title: Reading Drill — Testing recycled notebook covers — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing recycled notebook covers — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The stationery designer in Cairnford received an old report about covers bending inside crowded schoolbags. The report compared the number of lasting bends, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the a load test rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered three weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include different book sizes. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a stiffer folded edge as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
